title: Mohammed VI Mosque, Coquimbo
geometryBasis: Named OSM building polygon with 13 corners, Wikidata-matched worship location and mapped Cerro Dominante.
sectionBasis: Built 2004–2006 in reinforced concrete. The center supplies the height and minaret prototype. ONAR independently documents two prayer rooms and approximately 40 metres for its minaret. Current ground and exterior ornament remain approximate.
limitations: The current mapped outline sets the footprint. The tower base position is inferred from the west square projection. The hall roof, window groupings and entrance detail are estimated.
The operator lists 43 metres for the total tower height and ONAR lists a 40-metre minaret. The model treats 43 as the finial top, while the highest masonry course is approximately 40 metres.
The tower decoration represents the documented Koutoubia design family. Exact ornament, roof cupola visibility and external masonry sections remain approximate.
The original hill has not been reshaped. Surrounding park facilities, artwork, library and prayer hall interiors are outside the exterior scope.
